proposal.rationale: The narrative reports a BCI message followed by multiple dash lights on a 2019 Nissan Armada. No rulebook entry matched and no fault codes or conditions were provided. Recall 19V654000 concerns rear camera display settings, and similar cases report BCI malfunction with multiple ADAS warnings, so a standard ADAS diagnostic scan and functional check is appropriate rather than a targeted load test.

recalls.summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2018-2019 Nissan Altima, Armada, Frontier, Kicks, Leaf, Maxima, Murano, NV, NV200, Pathfinder, Rogue, Rogue Sport, Sentra, Titan, Titan Diesel, Versa Note and Versa Sedan vehicles, as well as Infiniti Q50, Q60, QX30 and QX80 vehicles.  Additionally included are 2019 Nissan GT-R and Taxi and Infiniti QX50, QX60, Q70, Q70L vehicles.  The back-up camera and display settings can be adjusted such that the rear view image is no longer visible and the system will retain that setting the next time the vehicle is placed in reverse.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."
